units: <cite ref="Ketubot 43a:12">Keth. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>לה׳</he> concerning the surplus of the value of labor over the cost of sustenance.
<cite ref="Ketubot 66a:3">Ib. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ע״י הדחק</he> a surplus gained through an extraordinary exertion.
<cite ref="Gittin 12b:14">Ib. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>לה׳</he> for additional support (not included in the sustenance furnished by the master).
